filing_note: This 10-K was filed by Supernova Partners Acquisition Company II, Ltd. (SPAC, CIK 0001838359) for fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2021. At the filing date the de-SPAC merger with Rigetti Holdings, Inc. had not yet closed (it closed March 2022). The 10-K therefore covers the SPAC shell and contains NO Rigetti operational disclosure: no DoD programs, no AFRL/DARPA contracts, no Program Elements, no qubit/quantum business narrative, no revenue, no customers. Confirmed by zero-hit grep across full 1.55MB filing for AFRL/DARPA/quantum/qubit/superconducting. The CIK 0001838359 is the SPAC's CIK (later assumed by the post-merger Rigetti Computing, Inc.), but this particular 10-K predates merger consummation. As a result, the J-Book Exposure Divergence pattern cannot be tested against this filing — there are no J-Book-grounded claims to extract. The framework's correct behavior is to flag STRUCTURAL_NO_OPERATING_CONTENT and emit only the SPAC-shell claims that DO appear (merger closing conditions, trust-account cash, going-concern).

extraction_summary.rationale: Pre-validated filing is a SPAC shell 10-K filed five days before the de-SPAC closed. No operating-company content exists to score against pentagon_jbook. Per cohort framing (blinded, do-not-pick-own-filing), this is the result the framework must surface honestly.
